comment: fix: Restore short-circuit semantics in Vega-Lite expressions and warn and exclude rows when filter evaluation fails. Nonaggregate vertical bar charts now render the native no-data display when successful filtering exhausts populated data whose encoded fields validate before the exhausting filter, preserving healthy concat siblings. Empty source data, invalid encoded fields, and filter-error depletion retain strict validation and can throw during rendering. Callers needing containment of invalid child specs must handle render errors externally. Other marks retain their existing empty-data behavior. Filters remain display-only, not authorization controls.
